userStories.title: Council owns its budget stop
userStories.description: As an advisor, I want `/council` to own its budget stop so that `/council` names no missing `/delegate` rule.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/council/SKILL.md` § 3 states that, at budget exhaustion, the advisor dispatches no further worker and reports `PARTIAL` with the accepted observations and the missing coverage.
`.agro/skills/council/references/scenarios.md` § Partial evidence and critic failure names the same council budget stop.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/skills/council/SKILL.md .agro/skills/council/references/scenarios.md` reports no finding on a line that this story adds.
userStories.notes: Worker model: opus (provider default). C1-C2 reasoned: advisor read council/SKILL.md section 3 and scenarios.md; both name the council budget stop with PARTIAL; SKILL.md adds BLOCKED when no observation exists, consistent with section 5. C3 executed: git grep budget-stop .agro/skills exit 1, no lines. C4 executed: ste-check.sh on both files exit 0. C5 executed: pnpm test exit 0. C6 executed: pnpm typecheck exit 0.
